name: Sossusvlei
tagline: Red dunes and the ghost trees of Deadvlei
summary: Sossusvlei in the Namib Desert has some of the world's tallest red sand dunes. Climb Dune 45 or Big Daddy at sunrise, walk among the 900-year-old dead camelthorn trees of Deadvlei, explore Sesriem Canyon and stargaze under some of the darkest skies on earth.
seasonNote: May to September is cooler; summer days are very hot.
arrival: 5 hours' drive from Windhoek, or fly in by light aircraft to lodges.
gettingAround: 4x4 self-drive; a shuttle covers the last 5 km of sand.
cashTip: The Namibian dollar is pegged 1:1 to the rand, and rand is accepted. Fill up with fuel and cash in towns; lodges take cards.
foodTip: Game meat at lodges, Namibian beer and apple pie at Solitaire on the drive in.
baseArea: Sesriem or lodges near the park gate
